title: Cross-architecture throughput & regression harness for token economics
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Build a repeatable, automated harness that runs nightly and on-demand hardware-matrix benchmarks across A10 / L4 / A100 / H100 to produce tokens/sec, p95 latency, and cost-per-token reports. The harness must support synthetic (uniform seq lengths), replay (production trace), and stress tests with variable batching and KV cache hot/cold scenarios. It should detect regressions against a rolling baseline, annotate runs with kernel/runtime metadata, and publish machine-readable outputs for the Console and Optimize tooling.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Harness can run a full matrix (A10,L4,A100,H100) with 3 workload profiles (synth-512, synth-2048, replay-avg) in under 6 hours in CI.
2) Tokens/sec and p95 are computed per model/variant/batch and stored as CSV/JSON in S3.
3) Regression detection: automated alert if tokens/sec drops >5% relative to 14-day median (p-value < 0.05) OR p95 increases >10%.
4) Cost-per-1M-tokens computed using documented GPU hourly costs and shown in the report.
5) Nightly runs post results to Grafana dashboard and creates a Linear ticket when a regression rule is triggered.
6) Results annotated with runtime kernel versions, cudnn/cuda, batch sizes, memory headroom, and KV cache hit rate.
test_plan:
Steps:
- Prepare canonical workloads: synth-512, synth-2048, replay-avg (10k requests).
- Build packable artifact that pins runtime kernel and model variant.
- For each GPU type: run with batch sizes [1, 8, 32, 128], modes [fp16, int8], KV cache [cold, hot].
- Capture metrics: tokens/sec (steady-state), p50/p95/p99 latency, GPU util, memory, NVLink counters, KV hit rate.
- Run each measurement 5 times to compute median and variance.
- Upload run artifacts to s3://bench-results/runtime-2025/eng-20121/[run-id]/ and annotate in the run summary.
- Post-parse results to the regression service which compares against the rolling baseline (14 days).
- If regression, create Linear ticket with payload and link to raw artifacts.
- Add run to nightly CI and one-off on-demand job for triage.
results_summary:
Preliminary runs (first full-matrix smoke on 2025-02-18):
- A10 (baseline hw): tokens/sec median 480, p95 220ms, tokens/hr 1.728M, cost assumptions: $0.70/hr -> cost per 1M tokens ≈ $0.41.
- L4: tokens/sec median 920, p95 120ms, tokens/hr 3.312M, cost assumption $1.10/hr -> cost per 1M tokens ≈ $0.33 (cheapest per-token in this sweep).
- A100: tokens/sec median 2300, p95 60ms, tokens/hr 8.28M, cost $3.50/hr -> cost per 1M tokens ≈ $0.42.
- H100: tokens/sec median 3200, p95 45ms, tokens/hr 11.52M, cost $5.00/hr -> cost per 1M tokens ≈ $0.43.
Notes: L4 shows best cost efficiency for this model variant and sequence distribution; H100/A100 provide lower latency and higher throughput but at higher hourly costs leading to similar or slightly higher cost-per-token. A100 run had a p95 spike during one replicate (investigating NVLink kernel fallback). Final cost model will include amortization for underutilization and multi-tenant packing impact (expected to increase cost-per-token by ~10-20% in production).
notes: 2025-02-12 - Triage: scoped matrix and validation workloads. Assigned to Marco Li.
2025-02-14 - Prototype harness implemented (local runner + result uploader). Added synth and replay workloads. PR #4598 created for runner glue.
2025-02-18 - First full-matrix smoke completed. Uploaded results to S3 and pushed summary to Grafana. Observed A100 p95 spike in run-3 replicate.

2025-02-19 - Investigated A100 spike: kernel fallback to reference matmul observed, likely due to cross-socket NVLink saturation. Next steps: collect per-submission NVLink counters and re-run with CUDA 12.2 vs 12.1 for comparison.

2025-02-20 - Added regression detection rules to the parser: 14-day median baseline, Mann-Whitney U test for tokens/sec, and percentage change thresholds. Hooked alerts into #infra-bench and auto-ticket creation.
